author: Ben Champion
name: Weather
description: Local weather for the live screen: temperature now, and rain by part of day. Set a location below; the skin draws it in the bottom-right corner.

Location.label: Location
Location.description: A town or suburb, e.g. "Brunswick, AU". Looked up once and remembered as coordinates.

RefreshMinutes.label: Refresh every (minutes)
RefreshMinutes.description: How often to ask for a new reading. 30 is plenty; below 10 is ignored.

Units.label: Units
Units.description: "metric" for °C and mm, "imperial" for °F and inches. Leave blank to follow the skin.

ok.description: false when there is no usable reading — no location set, or the fetch failed and the cache is stale.

reason.description: why ok is false; absent when ok is true.

place.description: The resolved place name, as the skin should display it.

observedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the reading, in the location's own timezone.

ageMinutes.description: How long ago the reading was fetched. The skin hides the widget past two hours.

isDay.description: Whether it is daylight at the location — the skin picks a sun or moon mark.

code.description: WMO weather code, which the skin maps to one of its marks.

temperature.description: Air temperature now, in the unit named by `units`.

dewPoint.description: Dew point, same unit as temperature. Computed from temperature and humidity.

wind.description: Wind speed, km/h for metric or mph for imperial.

windFrom.description: Compass point the wind is coming from, e.g. NW.

units.description: Which unit set every value above is in.

periods.description: The next THREE parts of the day, FORWARD ONLY — the one running now first. Each carries {id, label, fromHour, toHour, tomorrow, probability, amount}. The corner draws the first two; the modal draws all three.

message.description: The reading in one line, for a client with nowhere to put the detail.
